bullets: 16.2M TEU on order, 46.5% of the fleet: a post-2009 peak (Taylor 2026); Linerlytica: 1,925 ships, 15.6M TEU
About 5.4M TEU ordered in 2025, another 4.4–4.9M TEU so far in 2026
The orderbook covers 4–4.5 years of deliveries, against a 2–2.5 year norm
theory: Fallacy of composition: each order is rational for one carrier, but together they add far more ships than demand can fill.
case: MSC: 3.38M TEU on order, 45% of its own fleet. Hapag-Lloyd: 0.49M TEU, 20% (Alphaliner).
speakerNotes: Req 1, orderbook tab of the team doc. Range: BIMCO >14M TEU (42%), Linerlytica 15.6M (45%), Taylor 16.2M (46.5%). 2028-29 deliveries (~10.3M TEU) are close to 30% of today's fleet. Drivers section to be rewritten.
